Name: Black Hole
Text: Each player may discard up to two cards. For each card less than two that a player discards, that player loses {4 Authority}

Name: Bombardment
Text: Each player either destroys a base they control or loses {6 Authority}

Name: Comet
Text: Each player may scrap up to two cards in their hand or discard pile.

Name: Supernova
Text:
Each player loses {5 Authority}
Scrap all cards in the trade row.

Name: Trade Mission
Text: The player currently taking their turn gains {4 Trade} and may put the next ship they acquire this turn on top of their deck. Each other player draws two cards.

Name: Warp Jump
Text: Each player draws three cards, then puts two of those cards back on top of their deck in any order.
